subject: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships

Lauren / Karthik —

Quick summary: Centauri (enterprise account) flagged a 38% surge in inference spend this month tied to our current routing behavior (their multi-model pipeline is hitting the higher-cost routing path more often). We surfaced that the Smart Routing optimization (sequence-aware region+variant routing) that would materially reduce token spend is still queued for the 2.1 rollout (sprint 4), currently scheduled for mid-May.

They’re asking for a short-term commercial accommodation (one-time provisional credit or rebate) to bridge the delta while we land the routing change. Customer is upset but not yet escalated to legal — they asked me to coordinate commercial + product timeline.

Attached: centauri-usage-summary-mar2027.csv (breakdown by model variant and region), provisional-credit-request-form.pdf (customer-submitted remediation request).

What I need from you:
- Lauren: a quick estimate of a one-time credit in dollars we can offer (range) without breaking quota policies — they request something that offsets ~50% of the delta for Mar-Apr.
- Karthik: can you confirm product timeline and whether we can accelerate the Smart Routing change or provide a limited configuration toggle for Centauri in April?

I can loop Marcus if we need exec sign-off for an exception.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Exec, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships

Avery —

Thanks for the detail and the CSV. Quick first pass: if the customer wants to cover ~50% of the additional spend for Mar and Apr, rough ballpark credit across both months looks like $42k–$58k depending on how aggressive we are with proration and whether we include burst/egress charges. I’ll validate the numbers with billing (we need to ensure we don’t double-count Marketplace fees).

Policy note: we typically avoid recurring credits for product-delivery delays; one-time provisional credits that require exec approval are acceptable. If Marcus can sign off on a one-time concession, we can make it contingent on a mutual action plan (MAP) — commit to April fix validation and July production rollout.

I’ll ping Finance for the exact ledger entry and whether this should be processed as a contra-revenue item or invoice credit.

-Lauren
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@centauri.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships

Lauren — thanks, that range helps. I’ve looped Linda so Centauri can confirm they’ll sign a MAP. Linda — confirming they’re willing to sign a short MAP that includes:

- Redwood delivers Smart Routing enablement for their account in April (beta), with full rollout validation in June.
- Centauri provides a small test corpus and telemetry access for our SREs to validate cost profile.
- One-time commercial accommodation: request is 50% of the measured delta for Mar+Apr (they budgeted expecting the routing optimization).

Linda, happy to set a brief call today if you want to walk the MAP draft.

Avery

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships

Avery / Lauren —

Product note: current plan is Smart Routing 2.1 in mid-May as you said. We can carve out a limited account-targeted toggle for Centauri and run the beta in their tenant during April (non-destructive): on our side this requires a small ops window and one dedicated SRE/PM for the rollout — I can support that. The toggle should recover ~60–70% of the delta based on the telemetry in your CSV (assuming no behavior changes on the customer side).

If we can commit to an April beta and a June full rollout, I’m comfortable recommending a one-time credit at the lower end of Lauren’s band (so $42k) conditioned on:
- Signed MAP by 7 Apr
- Telemetry access for two weeks during the beta
- No changes to their load pattern that would materially increase peak token rate beyond the CSV baseline

We’ll need Marcus to OK the exception (policy + finance). If Marcus prefers, we can present a short memo with the MAP and cost calc.

Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships

Team —

I’ve reviewed the CSV and the ask. I approve a one-time provisional credit of $42,000 to Centauri contingent on the MAP conditions Karthik listed. Please proceed with these steps:

1) Avery: get the MAP signed by 7 Apr and obtain the telemetry access link.
2) Lauren: coordinate with Billing to issue a contra-revenue credit entry referencing deal CENT-2027-04-MLR; confirm GL impact and whether this should be processed in April close or May.
3) Karthik/Product: schedule the limited toggle rollout and assign an SRE. Provide a short post-beta summary to Marcus and Finance.

Note for records: flag this as an executive exception in our concessions tracker and attach the signed MAP and usage report.

Marcus
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@centauri.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provisional credit while ML routing optimization ships

Linda — very grateful for the quick coordination. We’ve attached a short MAP draft to the Drive link and will send a DocuSign after you confirm the wording (link in related_links). Marcus has approved a one-time $42,000 provisional credit contingent on the MAP and telemetry access.

Next steps (ownership):
- Linda / Centauri: sign MAP by 2027-04-07, provide telemetry access for the April beta window.
- Avery: submit the signed MAP + usage CSV to Finance and CC Marcus; I’ll also upload to concessions tracker.
- Lauren / Billing: create contra-revenue credit referencing CENT-2027-04-MLR and advise on accounting close.
- Karthik: kick off the account toggle and assign an SRE — slide into the April sprint.

I’ll schedule a 20-min alignment call first thing Monday to confirm sign-off and dates.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Exec, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
